name: Ode to Joy
description: Five independent, career-driven women living in the Ode to Joy apartment building navigate love, ambition, and personal growth as they chase fulfillment on their own terms. As they try to make it in the big city, each faces unique challenges and romantic entanglements while discovering who they truly want to be.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Andie travels to Phuket for vacation after breaking up with her boyfriend. The vacation is not as relaxing as she wishes as new suitor follows her.
